baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Warriors of Chaos (Norse tribes); inferred where the books are silent; canon: WFB Warhammer Armies: Norsca (tribes led by Chieftains and Jarls); the mod's tribal law is law_chiefdom (#9037)
baseline.why: Norse tribes are jarl-led raiding confederacies: warrior caste, thing-moot assembly, consumption taxes, slave-taking, no schools or police; tribal Norse realms are Chiefdoms under a Chieftain, not monarchies (#9037)
